subject: Asian Games
hook: ASIAN GAMES IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Even though Egypt includes the Sinai Peninsula in Asia, it never competes in the Asian Games – it participates in the African Games instead.
angle_support: According to membership in the OCA, transcontinental Kazakhstan is an Asian country and could participate in the Asian Games, but this right could not apply to Egypt as the country had 6% of the territory on Sinai, participating in the African Games instead.
Turkey and Russia/Soviet Union — whose major geographical parts are located in the Asian continent — participate in the European Games rather than the Asian Games.
title: Why Egypt is banned from the Asian Games
description: Although Egypt possesses territory in Asia via the Sinai Peninsula, it is not part of the Asian Games. Membership relies on the Olympic Council of Asia rather than simple geography.
narration: ASIAN GAMES IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture every nation with territory in Asia competing there. It was closer to reality that geographical location does not guarantee entry into these continental multi-sport games. Egypt includes the Sinai Peninsula, which is physically part of Asia. Yet, the country never competes in the Asian Games. Instead, they participate in the African Games because membership depends entirely on the Olympic Council of Asia. Geography is only a suggestion in the world of international sports.
